verdict.rationale: The published ELSTER pages say paperless filing requires a free, one-time registration in Mein ELSTER that issues a certificate, and that document upload and e-invoice submission happen after login or with a user account. Nothing in the evidence documents a keyless or file-number entry path into the core online flow. The third-party software channel and einfachELSTER are mentioned, but nothing says either works without an account.
